data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'bélekos', meaning 'God's strength'. This name has biblical connections in the Old Testament, where 'Bilek' is mentioned as a servant of King Hezekiah. The name Bilek carries the meaning “God's strength” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Bilek usually hope their child will grow to embody god's strength and live with faith, good character and purpose.

The name conveys the idea of a strong and protective deity that is a source of enduring faith and hope. More generally, the name 'Bilek' can serve as a reminder of the power and endurance inherent within both our personal strength and our beliefs.
